description: This file defines a PHP interface 'FilterDefinition' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\Filter'. It specifies methods for normalizing filter objects to an array and retrieving metadata as a ParameterBag. The file appears to be part of a reporting system in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the object data as an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata as a ParameterBag object, or null if not set.
